title: Taking food as a hotel waiter and being called a thief
summary: Working as a waiter, he smuggles chicken to hungry musicians until a new steward stops it and a friend accuses him of selling the food.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And so I went on, and at last I got this job. And there was a lot of others around there, more unfortunate than I was. So, I was working in this hotel. I learned how to wait good then, because I used to go up and help my father, so I knew something about waiting, anyway.

So, what happened was that these guys would say, "Sam, hey, we haven't had nothing to eat today, we haven't scoffed today.", they said, "can't you pick up a couple of pork chops up there or something and bring down here?" Well, one of the waiters, I told him, I said, "How do you get something out of here?", I said to one of the older waiters, and he said, "Well, you know the way I do, I got a leather pocket put inside of my waiter's jacket. And so won't no grease come through, you put this leather pocket in there, and when"-- we served the American Plan, you know, in the hotel -- "well, you go in there and say, 'five orders of chicken'". Well, maybe you only got three people out there, wasn't nobody'd bother you. So, two orders, you shoved in your pocket, see. And I'd take food across to the guys all the time. I'd be takin' them food. I didn't charge them nothin' for it, because I'm trying to be a big time man and be somebody, you know what I mean?

And so, we were getting along fine, until business started falling off in the hotel, and there wasn't no chicken, and they got a new steward or something. And he's been buying just enough for the people. There wasn't nothing left over.

So, one guy called me and said, "Man, you don't bring nothing no more. What's the matter? You must be selling that or doing -- what are you doing with the food?" And the guy said, "Oh, he been stealing that food and selling it to somebody." Well, that made me angry, cause I didn't want to be called a thief. So I said, "Look --", I used some four letter words, a couple of them, I said, "Look, you get your own damned chicken, I'm not getting nothing more.", I said, see? And I quit that stuff and I stopped that, see? Well, because, sooner or later I'd have been caught at it anyhow. And then this guy woke me up by calling me a thief, cause that's the last thing -- I had a good home and I was well raised, you know what I mean? And I couldn't stand nobody calling me no thief, so. And I'm feeding him, too. So I said, "Forget it, we're through with that." So I went on and just -- I was getting better, anyhow, with the music, and I got, then I got a job. And I got a chance to substitute for Eubie Blake was sick. And I got to substitute for him, and I was gettin' into the big time, then.
